title: Star Wolves 3 (Wine) trackpad: keys as held mouse buttons

rules.description: SW3 [required]: hold left Option = hold right mouse button (Option+slide = rotate, Shift then Option+slide = altitude, Option tap = order)
SW3 [optional]: hold right Option = hold middle mouse button (free-camera move, Free camera U/F9 only). Removes right Option character composition in the game window
